title: Chevron Houston Marathon 2026
location: Houston, 1001 Avenida De Las Americas, Houston, TX 77010, USA
about: *Note: This is not a Tradition Local Event - We like to highlight fun events in the Greater Houston Area

Chevron Houston Marathon Race Weekend offers excitement for every runner right in the heart of the Bayou City! Experience true Texas hospitality as the fourth-largest city in the nation cheers you on through 26.2 miles of the Chevron Houston Marathon, 13.1 Aramco Houston Half Marathon, or 3.1 miles of the We Are Houston 5K. Join us for the 54th running of the event in 2026, and what is sure to be an exciting weekend full of tradition and camaraderie.
View the schedule for the entire weekend here. Check out our Guide to the Chevron Houston Marathon here.

title: Taj A Sweet Cafe Coffee & Conversations [January]
location: Taj A Sweet Cafe, 5640 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77056, USA
about: Join us at this local coffee shop café for Coffee & Conversations, a relaxed, come-as-you-are gathering centered around meaningful connection, community, and great coffee. Set in a welcoming space, this is the perfect place to slow down, meet new people, and enjoy conversation in a comfortable, laid-back environment.

Conversation is easy and wide open. We love talking about mutual interests, food, travel, health, business, life, and everything under the sun. Come for a few minutes or stay the whole time. No agenda, no pressure, just good conversation.
What to expect
Fresh coffee and a welcoming vibe
Open, friendly conversation
Networking and genuine connection

title: Lunar New Year 2026: Celebrating the Year of the Horse
location: Houston, 1370 Southmore Blvd, Houston, TX 77004, USA
about: *Note: This is not a Tradition Local Event - We like to highlight fun events in the Greater Houston Area

2026 is the Year of the Horse — a symbol of energy, freedom, and forward momentum. The horse also represents strength, grace, and determination. Join Asia Society Texas in welcoming the Year of the Horse with vibrant performances, hands-on arts and craft activities, and delicious food — all inspired by Lunar New Year traditions across Asia!

Celebrate the new year as traditional lion dancers kick off the festivities outside on our festival lawn. Enjoy dynamic Chinese music and dance performances, get creative with Lunar New Year-themed crafts, and visit our The House of Pikachu: Art, Anime, and Pop Culture exhibition!
